light_description: Fieldfare's expanded Tube Screamer-style drive with 9V/18V headroom, low-push, high-cut and open/compress controls.
Boutique overdrive in Fieldfare Audio's current analog pedal catalog.
Current handmade German fuzz model in the Fieldfare Audio catalog.
Bass-focused analog distortion with Classic/Modern voicing and broad tone shaping.
High-gain distortion model positioned by Fieldfare in its high-gain catalog.
Current fuzz model shown alongside Fury in Fieldfare Audio's classic-fuzz collection.
Bionique Audio's first commercial pedal, launched in 2020 after Dan Poirier's earlier circuit experimentation; current Chimera page exposes multiple variants.
Current third-generation Chimera presentation in Bionique Audio's catalog.
RAT-inspired Quebec-made distortion/fuzz with stacked overdrive/distortion stages and F/D voicing.
High-gain stacked drive inspired by Tube Screamer and Distortion Plus circuits, with independent distortion increase switch.
Original AFA product, a modified Shin-Ei Superfuzz FY-6 variant and the starting point for the company's fuzz catalog.
Third-iteration Chemical Burn with expanded controls and switchable level boost, documented in 2023 development news.
AFA fuzz pedal descended from the builder's experimental gain work; current shop marks the pedal discontinued.
Second-iteration Baron Samedi documented in the builder's historical development material.
Original guitar-oriented AFA drive/filter design represented in historical module and pedal documentation.
Ground-up V2 redesign documented by AFA during its pandemic redesign cycle; current shop marks the pedal discontinued.
Original AFA bass-distortion family, later reworked into the Godeater V3 pedal and Godeater+.
Third-generation Godeater pedal adding balanced output and revised output mixer stage.
Current expanded Godeater+ with sidechain, crossover and output-splitting features plus internal high-voltage operation.
Dual independent overdrive/distortion pedal with series or parallel routing and selectable clipping/range modes.
Three-footswitch dual-fuzz design combining Chemical Burn and modified Big Muff-derived channels with pre-fuzz delay and modulation options.
Original flagship overdrive family; current OKKO catalog and anniversary material identify Diablo as the pedal that started the company.
Limited 20th-anniversary Diablo edition, explicitly limited to 50 pieces with big-box enclosure and premium component selection.
Two-channel dynamic overdrive/distortion with independently adjustable channels and 6V-18V internal dynamic range.
Gregor Hilden signature variant of the Diablo with independent post-drive boost section and revised feel controls.
Current Dirty Diablo variation of the classic Diablo family, offered in black and white commercial states.
Current OKKO drive marketed as a classic circuit with a new appearance.
Dual stacking overdrive and preamp model in the current OKKO catalog.
Aggressive bass distortion in OKKO's current pedal catalog.
Hybrid gain pedal combining overdrive, fuzz and preamp functions with selectable bias and buffered/unbuffered operation.
Big-box version of OKKO's Big Fucking Green Russian Muff With Benefits fuzz.
Limited white enclosure commercial state of the Big Fucking Green Russian Muff With Benefits.
